title: Real Estate & Property Management Starter Pack
client: Independent Brokers, Property Managers, Short-Term Rental Operators
industry: Real Estate • Property Management • SMB Automation
challenge: Real estate professionals struggle with manual lead management, missed follow-ups, and fragmented workflows across multiple tools. Independent brokers, property managers, and short-term rental operators waste hours on repetitive tasks: manually entering leads from forms, drafting follow-up emails, coordinating appointments, managing contracts, and tracking documents. Without automation, agents lose leads to faster competitors, miss appointment opportunities, and spend valuable time on administrative work instead of closing deals.
whyNow: Increasing competition for leads in real estate markets
Need for faster response times to capture hot leads
Growing complexity in managing multiple properties and clients
Time wasted on manual data entry and follow-up tasks
Lack of integrated systems for lead-to-close workflows
whyNowSummary: Real estate professionals are losing deals to competitors who respond faster and manage workflows more efficiently. The market demands instant response times, seamless client experiences, and automated workflows that free agents to focus on relationship-building and closing deals rather than administrative tasks.
solution: A comprehensive real estate automation starter pack that automates lead routing, follow-up communication, appointment booking, contract management, and document workflows. The system integrates lead forms with CRM, auto-drafts follow-up emails and texts, routes leads intelligently based on criteria, syncs calendars for seamless booking, manages contracts through DocuSign, and organizes documents automatically. Phase 2 adds AI-powered property summaries to accelerate buyer engagement.

highlights: Automated lead routing based on ZIP code, price range, and lead score
AI-drafted follow-up emails and SMS messages

phases.name: Phase 1 — Lead Routing & Follow-Up Engine
delivered: Lead form (Typeform or IDX) → auto-entry into CRM
AI drafts personalized follow-up email + text message
Auto-notify agent based on ZIP code, price range, or lead score
Intelligent lead routing to appropriate agent
phases.value: 90% faster lead response time, 95%+ follow-up completion rate, no leads fall through cracks, agents focus on qualified opportunities

phases.name: Phase 2 — Appointment Booking & Reminder Flow
delivered: Sends automated pre-call reminder via SMS/email
No-show detection with automatic reschedule offer
Two-way calendar sync for availability management
phases.value: 25-30% improvement in appointment show rate, reduced no-shows, seamless scheduling experience, time saved on manual coordination

phases.name: Phase 3 — Contract & Document Management
phases.purpose: Automate Contract Workflows and Document Organization
delivered: Buyer/Seller forms → routed to DocuSign templates automatically
Completed contracts auto-saved to Google Drive/Dropbox
Folder link sent to client + agent with document checklist
Audit trail for all document interactions
phases.value: 60% faster contract processing, organized document management, reduced errors, improved client experience, compliance tracking

phases.name: Phase 4 — AI Deal Summary Bot (Bonus)
phases.purpose: Accelerate Buyer Engagement with Property Intelligence
delivered: Scrapes MLS notes + agent information automatically
Auto-generates comprehensive property summary PDF for buyer leads
Instant property summaries for faster decision-making
phases.value: Faster buyer engagement, higher conversion rates, professional property presentations, time saved on manual research

demoStory: New lead submits inquiry form → System captures lead data → AI drafts personalized follow-up email and SMS → Lead routed to appropriate agent based on criteria → Agent receives notification → Lead books appointment via Calendly → System syncs to Google Calendar → Automated reminders sent → Appointment confirmed → If no-show, system detects and offers reschedule → Contract initiated → Forms routed to DocuSign → Completed contract auto-saved → Folder link sent to all parties → Deal progresses seamlessly with minimal manual intervention.

The starter pack eliminates administrative burden, ensures no lead is missed, and enables agents to focus on what they do best: building relationships and closing deals.
